risks.title: Operational execution and organizational change in North America
risks.summary: The shift in the Distribution operating model (from a branch-based to a sales/operations model) caused reduced local agility, lower customer wallet share, and service issues. Despite H2 2025 improvement, the risk remains: volumes below expectations, weak private-label conversion, and dependence on the new model's stabilization for 2026 growth.
risks.score_rationale: Major risk explicitly detailed in Item 1A and CEO/Chairman statements. Intense language ("execution issues", "challenging year", "operating model change"). Trend: up (persistent H1 2025 issues, partial H2 recovery). Critical weight: Distribution is Bunzl's largest business, directly impacting operating margin (8.3% vs 8.6% prior year).

risks.title: Exposure to economically sensitive sectors
risks.summary: Bunzl is heavily exposed to cyclical sectors (foodservice, convenience stores, food processors) that contracted significantly in 2025 due to macroeconomic uncertainty and consumer pressure. The CEO noted that "weak demand in North America, particularly from food processors and convenience stores," limited H2 progress. This sector exposure creates revenue and margin volatility risk.
risks.score_rationale: Explicit sector risk in CEO and Chairman statements. Moderately intense language ("challenging macroeconomic backdrop", "pressure on foodservice and convenience stores"). Trend: up (amplified impact in 2025, ongoing uncertainty). High weight: foodservice and convenience stores represent major segments vulnerable to economic cycles.

risks.title: Market fragmentation and acquisition integration risk
risks.summary: Bunzl continues its consolidation strategy via bolt-on acquisitions in fragmented markets (8 acquisitions in 2025 across 7 countries). The risk lies in its ability to identify, integrate, and realize expected synergies (e.g., Nisbets in UK & Ireland delivered margin gains, but execution has been variable). Spend slowed in 2025 (£132m vs pipeline) reflecting macroeconomic impact on valuations and target availability.
risks.score_rationale: Strategic business risk mentioned in Chairman statement ("consolidation opportunity"). Moderate language ("bolt-on acquisitions", "fragmented markets"). Trend: stable (strategy ongoing, but spend slowed to £132m in 2025 vs expectations). Medium weight: acquisitions are a growth pillar (9% CAGR since 2004), but integration and synergies require execution.

risks.title: Supply chain disruptions and trade tariffs
risks.summary: Supply chain disruptions related to trade tariffs affected North American performance in 2025, creating volume pressure and price volatility. The CEO noted that "sectors such as foodservice and convenience stores felt a more significant impact from the economic environment," amplified by tariff disruptions. Risk of continuation in 2026 depending on trade policy developments.
risks.score_rationale: Explicit risk in CEO statement ("supply chain disruption related to tariffs"). Moderate language (specific mention but not dramatized). Trend: up (tariffs impacted H2 2025, 2026 uncertainty). Medium weight: direct impact on volumes and pricing in North America.

risks.title: Competition and customer pricing pressure
risks.summary: Bunzl faces increased pricing pressure from customers (especially in Distribution) passing on economic pressures. The CEO reported a "loss of share of wallet with certain customers" due to centralized processes and reduced local agility. While new customer wins were achieved in H2 2025, the risk remains of margin erosion if competition intensifies.
risks.score_rationale: Implicit risk in CEO statement ("price pressure from customers", "loss of share of wallet"). Moderate language (contextual mention). Trend: stable (ongoing pressure, partially offset by new business wins). Medium weight: affects margins and organic growth.

risks.title: Customer retention and service quality dependency
risks.summary: Bunzl's model relies heavily on customer retention and service quality ("one-stop-shop, on-time and in-full"). The organizational change in Distribution caused temporary service degradation and wallet share loss. Although H2 2025 showed improvement ("significantly improved service levels"), the risk remains that future disruptions could affect customer loyalty and organic growth.
risks.score_rationale: Core business risk mentioned in Chairman statement ("strong customer retention" as strength, but implicitly vulnerable). Moderate language ("service levels" improved in H2, but prior issues). Trend: up (service issues in H1 2025 linked to organizational change). Medium weight: Bunzl's model depends on service and customer loyalty.

risks.title: Operating margin volatility and inflationary pressure
risks.summary: Bunzl experienced operating margin compression in 2025 (7.7% vs 8.3%), driven by Distribution and weakness in other large businesses. While deflation in cleaning & hygiene (France, UK) moderated pressure, North American tariffs and customer pricing pressure continue to weigh. The CEO noted "stabilization" in H2, but margin volatility risk persists depending on macroeconomic conditions and cost actions.
risks.score_rationale: Explicit operational risk in financial review (operating margin 7.7% vs 8.3% prior year, -60 bps). Moderately intense language ("margin decline", "deflation"). Trend: up (ongoing pressure, moderated in H2). Medium weight: direct impact on profitability and EPS.

risks.title: Geographic concentration risk and North America dependency
risks.summary: Bunzl generates 53% of its revenue in North America, creating significant geographic concentration. Execution issues in Distribution (its largest business) in 2025 had a disproportionate impact on overall performance. While Rest of World and UK & Ireland showed resilience, the risk remains that North American difficulties could affect consolidated growth and shareholder returns.
risks.score_rationale: Implicit risk in revenue structure (53% North America). Moderate language ("largest business", "execution issues"). Trend: stable (historical concentration, but diversification ongoing). Medium weight: North America represents over half of revenue and faced the largest challenges in 2025.
